description: IFM solves multi-ion continuity, momentum and energy equations for the global ionosphere. It follows plasma along magnetic flux tubes and supports configurable spatial and temporal resolution. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documentation establishes the method and altitude range, but this page supplies no execution link. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
